subject: general
question: Popular Bollywood actor Kriti Sanon is a trained __________ dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kriti Sanon** is a popular Bollywood actor known for her roles in various hit movies.
 
• She is a trained **Kathak** dancer, which is a classical dance form originating from northern India.
 
• Kathak involves intricate footwork, spins, and expressive gestures, and is often performed to classical music.
 
• Training in Kathak requires dedication and practice, showcasing Kriti Sanon's commitment to her art.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kriti Sanon** has a background in engineering, having completed her degree before entering the film industry.
 
• She made her **Bollywood debut** in the movie **Heropanti** opposite Tiger Shroff.
 
• Besides Kathak, Kriti has also shown her versatility by performing various dance styles in her movies.
 
• Her dedication to both her acting and dancing careers has made her a prominent figure in Bollywood.
